     # default ignore list for detailed views
     IGNORE = ('module', 'docuri', 'version_added', 'short_description', 'now_date', 'plainexamples', 'returndocs', 'collection')
 
+    @classmethod
+    def tty_ify(cls, text):
+        """Render documentation macros for terminal output."""
+        macros = re.compile(r'(?<!\w)(?:[IBMUCRL]\([^()]*\)|HORIZONTALLINE)')
+
+        def replace(match):
+            token = match.group(0)
+            if token == 'HORIZONTALLINE':
+                return '\n-------------\n'
+            name, arguments = token.split('(', 1)
+            arguments = arguments[:-1]
+            if name == 'L':
+                text, url = arguments.split(',', 1)
+                return "%s <%s>" % (text, url.strip())
+            if name == 'R':
+                return arguments.split(',', 1)[0]
+            if name == 'I' or name == 'C':
+                return "`%s'" % arguments
+            if name == 'B':
+                return "*%s*" % arguments
+            if name == 'M':
+                return "[%s]" % arguments
+            return arguments
+
+        return macros.sub(replace, text)
+
     def __init__(self, args):
 
         super(DocCLI, self).__init__(args)
